{{Otheruses|ice}}
'''Ice sailing craft''' were specialized craft for [[Ice-sailing|sailing]] across the ice [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Neftali/Legends|Neftali]]. Each ices sailing craft was outfitted with a [[Homing beacon/Legends|homing beacon]] to allow sailors and sight-seers who rented them from [[Ambar's Big Game, Tackle, and Gear Shop]] to find their way back to shore. More expensive models incorporated [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] engines.<ref name="BSS">''[[The Black Sands of Socorro]]''</ref>
